close_reason: Extended TeletexString/BMPString scope note with encoding requirements
description: Comments note that TeletexString and BMPString are deferred to v0.2 (RFC 5280 §7.1 / RFC 4518 §2.6), but don't document the required changes: (1) which encoding tables (cp850? ISO-8859-1?) are needed, (2) whether NFKC decomposition applies to these types, (3) whether any_to_str_bytes signature must change, (4) what test vectors to use (PKITS, external oracles?). Clarify scope and acceptance criteria for v0.2 legacy string type support so future implementers don't guess.
title: RFC 4518 v0.2 scope: document TeletexString/BMPString normalization requirements
